parsed.note_claim: The 13,000 figure reflects cumulative homicide convictions among non-citizens on ICE's non-detained docket as of mid-2024, not murders by illegal immigrants committed in 2024, and many are incarcerated.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The new figures released by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) do show some 13,000 non-citizens convicted of homicide were on its records and not in its custody. However, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS)... said the figures cover a period of many years... It also said that those on the list may not be in ICE custody but could be detained or in prison under the supervision of other agencies.
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly confirms that the 13,000 figure refers to cumulative homicide convictions on ICE's non-detained docket spanning decades, not murders committed in 2024, and that many individuals may be incarcerated by other agencies.
